12-year history of well-controlled HIV
undetectable viral load, CD4+ count 1184 × 10^6 cell/liter
low-grade fever (37.5°)

vesicular and umbilicated lesions on genitals
fever up to 39°C
chest pain without irradiation
shortness of breath

Echocardiography: Left ventricle diastolic diameter of 59 mm, hypokinetic left ventricle with EF 50%
